scope: isolated official VIRAT Ground 2.0 train/val ROI pilot
dataset_boundary: use road_roi_dataset_virat for VIRAT work; road_roi_dataset is a combined legacy pilot and must not be used as a VIRAT-only evaluation set
test_boundary: split=test scenes were viewed for coordinate/ROI mapping QA and are development holdout only; pixels are not imported, trained on, or scored, and a strict blind final test requires new unseen scenes

sampling.algorithm: thin each track by zero-based frame distance, evenly cap per track, then evenly cap per scene/label
sampling.reason: avoid adjacent frames and long/static tracks overwhelming the small pilot

limitations: Spatial mapping contact sheets passed independent visual QA; semantic difficulty and source resolution remain limitations.
VIRAT usage-agreement acceptance was confirmed by the user on 2026-09-27 and recorded with a hashed local receipt
reviewed distant pedestrians can be only 2-6 pixels wide in the 256x144 analysis image, which is a model-capability limit
official boxes test classification input only; CCL candidate quality is a separate experiment
development holdout split has viewed selection metadata/contact sheets only and is absent from road_roi_dataset; it is not a strict blind test
binary classifier has no invalid-candidate rejection path
